sections.heading: About Me

layers.name: Intro paragraph
layers.text:
Hi , I am Abbie Yeung ! A Graduated Student from Creative Media.
I am an artist focused on multimedia and illustration design, skilled at blending delicate visual language into digital media. My design style is clean yet expressive, with a strong sense of storytelling. Through my work, I aim to build visual experiences that are both aesthetically pleasing and emotionally engaging.

layers.name: Second paragraph
layers.text: I believe that great design is more than a visual outcome; it’s a vessel for meaning. In every project, I remain committed to a core concept, solving problems through pure form to build a sincere connection between brand and audience.

sections.heading: About This Project
sections.text:
Garden of Sound and Memory is an immersive installation that blends interactive animation with real-time audio. Audiences navigate a seasonal cycle, experiencing a poignant narrative of connection and separation through music they help generate.
The plot of the animation is based on our memories, and we use those experiences to write a story to express the feelings in those memories.
One of the stories is about the connection between the environment and humans, and the other story is about the connection between people.

sections.heading: The artwork
sections.textAfter:
The installation keeps looping the both sides of the story from spring to winter,
the audiance can generate music in the interactive part to help the story continues.

sections.heading: Animation Breakdown
sections.text:
The animation part of Garden of Sound and Memory is based on motion graphic,
including character modeling, rigging, and animating.
